draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.strengthQuote: Able to gain depth quickly with his backpedal.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.10, the 126th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 10th of 20 at S. He went 97th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (126th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 57 tackles in 2021, 12th of 19 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Detroit Lions (physically unable to perform). 55 career games and 52 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 14 in 2024. Weak spots: missed tackle rate 18.2% (3rd percentile). Played 6 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-4 safety who played: 28.6% season snap share against a median of 72.3%, below the norm.
